title: e2e
brief: Agent-oriented end-to-end testing framework for web and mobile apps from Oskar Kwasniewski and the Tester Army team, shared after porting React Native Pager View's test suite from Maestro.
details: An X announcement from Oskar Kwasniewski of "e2e," a new agent-oriented testing framework — he ported React Native Pager View's test suite from Maestro to it as the proving ground. The link is the announcement only; the framework itself was still being built at announcement time. (x.com is not directly fetchable from this environment; the breakdown reflects the announcement's subject as curated.)
